observations: Blue 100cc-style commuter motorcycle, likely a Chinese-made clone of the Suzuki AX100 shape.
Tank decal reads 'AX100' in photo 0 and photo 1.
Seat/tail panel shows a brand name 'MUONER' in photo 1 and photo 2.
Oyo state plate number visible in photo 2 (partially readable, e.g. '...724-RU').
Aftermarket LED headlight unit fitted in place of stock headlamp (photo 0).
White plastic fender/mudguard zip-tied to the front fork, not properly mounted (photo 0).
Red/orange grips, aftermarket mirrors, and a plastic jerrycan-like object strapped to the frame (photo 2) suggest non-stock modifications.
Rear tyre tread looks worn/shallow in photo 1 and 2.
No odometer, engine, or chassis number visible in any photo.
No photo shows the engine running, lights on, or the bike in motion.

claims.claim: Lately used by giveaway (implying lightly/occasionally used)
claims.evidence: No usage history, logbook, or odometer shown in any photo.
Photos show cosmetic wear, a loosely zip-tied fender, and worn rear tyre; no proof of mechanical soundness.

claims.claim: Buy and drive to any location with battery everything (i.e., fully functional, battery included and working)
claims.evidence: No video or photo showing the engine starting, lights, horn, or battery charge indicator.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run reliably
risks.proof: Short video of the engine being started cold and idling

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or near end-of-life
risks.proof: Photo/video of headlight, horn, and indicators working with engine off (battery-only)

risks.risk: Frame or fork damage hidden under mud/paint, especially given the loosely attached fender which may indicate prior crash repair
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame welds, fork alignment, and the fender mounting points

risks.risk: Tyres are worn and may need replacement soon
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread depth on both tyres

risks.risk: No proof of ownership/registration papers matching the plate seen in photo 2
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle particulars/registration document showing matching plate number

risks.risk: Odometer reading and true mileage unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of the odometer/speedometer dial

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running, with it revved and sound audible
Photo of the vehicle registration/particulars document matching the visible plate number
Close-up photos of the frame, forks, and fender mounting area to check for accident damage
Photo/video confirming lights, horn, and indicators work off the battery alone
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a MUONER AX100-style 100cc motorcycle from visible decals, but all seller claims about condition, battery, and readiness to drive are unverified from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case (non-running, needing tyres and battery) until supporting proof is given.
